RESOLVED: Dear Dana, 

I am writing to follow up on your denied claim for the brain MRI on August 27. The denial reason was "prior authorization not on file". You have the right to appeal this decision within 180 days of the denial notice date. 

To appeal, your ordering provider, Dr. L. Okonjo, may submit a retrospective authorization request with clinical documentation supporting medical necessity. We have prepared an appeal form (FORM-APP-1) for your claim (CLM-550193). You can access the form at the URL we provided or by contacting us directly.

The exact deadline for your appeal is 180 days from the denial notice date. If you need help with the appeal process or have questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to us. We will decide on standard appeals within 30 calendar days.

Please let us know if there's anything else we can assist you with. 

Sincerely,
ARIA, Meridian Health Plan Member Services
